# priya: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: the rota explains the gaps and the odd hours, people explain context
values, places explain the two settings a session ever happens in. The
generator draws from these facts, so the record and this file agree by
construction.

## Household and people

- Leeds, UK. Shared terrace house with her partner Dev, also a nurse, on the
  opposite rota (when one is on days the other is often on nights - they
  see less of each other awake than either would like). No kids.
- Grace, a ward colleague: the shift priya picks up in week 3, on top of her
  own four, which is what turns an ordinary run of day-shifts into the
  five-in-a-row that empties that week of any training at all.

## Body and build

163 cm. Light build, long arms - which she brings up herself as both an
advantage and a curse for a strict pull-up: more leverage to fight against,
whatever the physiology actually says.

## Transport and routine

Bus and bike to the hospital depending on the shift and the weather. No car.
Weekly shape does not exist in the ordinary sense - it is a 16-day rota
cycle instead: four day shifts, four days off, four night shifts, four days
off, repeating. A day-shift block runs roughly 07:00-19:30; a night block
19:30-08:00. Training happens wherever it fits: before or after a shift, in
a break during one, or on a day off with nothing else claiming it.

## Places

- **Grocery**: Lidl, whichever is open on the way back from a shift.
- **Gym**: the hospital basement gym, free staff access, open all hours -
  the only place a 02:50 or 03:40 session (mid-shift, during a break) is
  possible. `sessions.jsonl` records this as `place: "hospital gym"` on
  shift days and `place: "home"` on days off, where the doorframe pull-up
  bar lives.
- **No pool.** Not part of this life.
- **Routes**: none, by design - she does not run or cycle a course, she
  trains strength. The one exception is recovery: an unmeasured walk along
  the canal towpath on a day off, which is why `sessions.jsonl` never
  carries a `distance_km` for her at all, walk or strength alike. No device
  means no distance, not even an estimated one.

## Calendar and milestones

- 2030-05-05: record starts, both goals set the same day.
- The 16-day rota cycle governs everything: four day shifts (2030-05-05 to
  05-08), four off (05-09 to 05-12), four nights (05-13 to 05-16), four off
  (05-17 to 05-20 in the unmodified cycle) - except 2030-05-20 is picked up
  as an extra shift for Grace, which turns the following four day-shifts
  (05-21 to 05-24) into five working days in a row before any rest.
- No holiday, no leave, appears anywhere in this record. What leave she has
  gets spent on sleep, not on the record.
- The one date given in advance in ARCS terms: the final pull-up check,
  2030-06-27, still `fail`, at a 2 second chin-over hold - the record's
  actual last word on the goal it was built around.
